credits.aboutText:
Friends, I built this game while learning Vue.js 3, with no ambitions of world domination :)

The idea goes back some fifteen years, to when the first season came out and I picked up the books. To keep track of all the plot threads, I kept turning to a fan encyclopedia and lingering over the illustrations by TheMico, concise and expressive. They captured the characters from the books far better than the show’s cast, and almost always matched how I pictured the heroes of the saga myself.

Now and then I would quiz my friends like this, and around that time I came up with the idea for this game. But the project kept growing, and only now have I got round to it.
